title: Your First 90 Days as Manager Network Governance
concept: The first 90 days establish credibility through listening, not enforcement. Understand the current state through stakeholder conversations, document existing governance gaps without demanding quick fixes, and align your mandate with the business driver that created the role. Assess capability and political resistance before designing the unified framework.
why: Your manager expects a unified COBIT-TM Forum framework spanning IT, network and cybersecurity. Success depends on understanding existing processes, politics and capability gaps before proposing governance that will meet resistance. Listen first.
question: Who will oppose the unified framework most strongly, and what existing process or authority will they defend?
source_label: COBIT 2019 Implementation: A Clear Guide to the 7 Phases
